This is an expanded vertical mini-menu above the existing lower-left gear, NOT a settings dialog or a new screen.

Input roles:
Image1 is EDIT TARGET: approved Prostokvashino gameplay image. Preserve exactly its classic Matroskin round portrait at top left, goals crate8/balloon4, moves24, starbar, veranda/garden backdrop,9x9board with identical colors and occupied cells and all specials/obstacles,bluewoodfooter,4toolslots and inventory3.
Image2 is STRUCTURE reference ONLY: demonstrate dimming and a stack of three round menu buttons rising above the lower-left gear. Do not copy the original red/desert palette, character, board, text, or any existing pixels. Render the three new buttons in the tactile enamel style of Image1.

ONLY CHANGES ALLOWED:
1. Apply an even semitransparent black/dark navy overlay to the ENTIRE Image1, darkening it around65%. It must dim the whole scene, Matroskin, HUD,board AND all4toolslots, inventorybadges andfooter.
2. Keep the existing bottom-left round gear button completely BRIGHT and undimmed at its existing exact position.
3. Above the gear, add exactly THREE new circular enamel buttons, vertically aligned with its center, roughly x=.097 of screen width. Each roundbutton diameter about .15 of screenwidth (~126px on841px canvas), thin cream enamel rim, subtle blueedge.
  - TOP: EXIT, centered at screen x .097,y .707, crimson red circular button, cream icon of a door/leftward exit arrow. Icon only, no word.
  - MIDDLE: SOUND, centered x .097,y .785, leaf-green circular button, cream speaker with two soundwave strokes. Icon only.
  - BOTTOM: MUSIC, centered x .097,y .864, leaf-green circular button, cream double musical note. Icon only.
The three menu buttons must be vibrant and undimmed and visually float above the dark overlay, like Image2. The menu is situated on the left edge, partially in front of the lower left board for the highestbutton; the existing board remains underneath, not reflowed or moved.

Invariants: Image1 screen aspect, crops, characterportrait, HUDnumbers, exactboardgrid/tile positions, footerposition, and fourtoolicons must remain identical. No shift of anybaseUI, no zoom, no new title, no textlabels, no window/panel backing, no closeX, no extra switches, no new notifications, no motionblur. Only three menu circles and dimming are added. Keep thin cream rims and existing paintedenamelstyle.
